slots.jd.remodeling.about:
About us and the job
Rowan Remodeling is an owner-run remodeling contractor in Eugene, OR. We remodel homes for local families and stand behind every job we finish. We are looking for a journeyman carpenter to join our crew. This job is on site every day, working alongside the owner and the rest of the team. We trust our carpenters to do careful work and to treat each client's home with respect.
slots.jd.remodeling.duties:
What the job involves
- Keep the site safe for the crew and the homeowner, and clean up at the end of each day
- Order lumber and materials ahead of time so the work keeps moving
- Frame walls and floors to plan, checking that everything is level, plumb and square
- Read the plans and confirm measurements before cutting
- Work with the owner to plan each stage of the remodel
slots.jd.remodeling.needs:
What you need
- 4 or more years of experience as a carpenter
- Hands-on skill in framing, stair building and concrete forming
- Experience with door and window installation
- Strong blueprint reading and careful measuring
- Good jobsite safety habits
- A State Apprenticeship Completion Certificate is required; a State Lead Carpenter Certificate is preferred
slots.r1.b1: Builds forms for concrete, using layout and measuring to set lines and grades before each pour, which has cut form rework by 20 percent.
slots.r1.b2: Reads plans and takes measurements before cutting finish trim, so casing and base fit tight on the first install.
slots.r1.b3: Orders lumber and materials for door and window installation from plan takeoffs, reducing wasted stock by 50 percent.
slots.r1.b4: Frames walls and floors to plan, using blueprint reading to check dimensions and openings before nailing off.
slots.r1.i1: Journeyman carpenter at Wren Valley Builders who keeps the site safe for the crew and the client throughout each job.
slots.r1.i2: Journeyman carpenter at Wren Valley Builders who reads plans and measures carefully so each job matches the drawings.
slots.r2.b1: Kept the site safe by applying jobsite safety practices, including daily cleanup and tool checks, cutting reported near misses by 45 percent.
slots.r2.b2: Installed doors, windows and trim, and assisted with concrete forming so openings lined up for the finish work.
slots.r2.b3: Built forms for concrete and assisted with cabinet installation, reducing material waste on form work by 15 percent.
slots.r2.b4: Read plans and measured heights to plan scaffold erection, setting up work platforms at the correct level for each task.
slots.r2.i1: Apprentice carpenter at Copperfield Construction who learned to read plans and measure accurately on active job sites.
slots.r2.i2: Apprentice carpenter at Copperfield Construction who installed doors, windows and trim while learning the carpentry trade.
slots.summary.1: Journeyman carpenter with 4 years of experience who completes work to code without close supervision. Skilled in cabinet installation, layout and measuring, and jobsite safety.
slots.summary.2: Carpenter at journeyman level with about 4 years in the trade, handling each task to code independently. Brings hands-on cabinet installation, careful layout and measuring, and steady jobsite safety habits.
